## Getting started
Extract the ZIP file, then run `LadderViewer.exe`.

Requirements: Windows x64, .NET 10 Desktop Runtime and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.

## Changes
### Improved
- Share toolbar controls, zoom behavior, search shortcuts and detail panel structure across the viewer screens.
- Limit native input loading to 1,000 files, 16 MiB per file and 64 MiB in total per load, including automatically checked comment CSVs. Show a Japanese error when a limit is exceeded.
- Validate transferred Base64 data without re-encoding it.
- Run type checks, formatting checks, tests and builds on main pushes and pull requests.
